description:
Keenable gives ChatGPT live web access through two read-only tools. Web Search returns ranked results for a query, each with a title, URL and snippet. Fetch Page Content takes any URL and returns the page's main content as clean markdown, so ChatGPT can read a source it just found.

Connect your Keenable account once to enable it. The intended flow is search to discover sources, then fetch the relevant ones, so an answer can cite what it is based on.

defaultPrompt: What has changed recently in retrieval-augmented generation? Cite your sources.
Summarize this page in five bullet points: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Model_Context_Protocol
Compare the main open-source vector databases and back each claim with a source.
